faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long does project implementation take?
faq.a1: Implementation time depends on project complexity. A simple website takes 2-4 weeks, a web application 1-3 months. After requirements analysis, we provide an exact timeline.
faq.q2: Do you offer support after project completion?
faq.a2: Yes, every project comes with a 6-month warranty. We also offer technical support and system maintenance packages.
faq.a3: We specialize in Laravel (PHP) and Vue.js. We also use MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker and many other proven technologies.
faq.q4: How much does it cost to create a website/application?
faq.a4: Prices start from 2500 PLN for a simple business card website. Each project is priced individually - we prepare a free quote within 24 hours.
faq.q5: Can I see your previous work?
faq.a5: Of course! Visit our Portfolio section where you'll find examples of completed projects from various industries.
faq.a6: Yes, we start every collaboration with a contract that protects both parties. Upon request, we also sign NDAs.
